p.src: 1  Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

en: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
u.src: 1  Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

p.src: 2  Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

en: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,
u.src: 2  Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

p.src: 3  praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

en: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,
u.src: 3  praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

p.src: 4  that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

en: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
u.src: 4  that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

p.src: 5  Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

en: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
u.src: 5  Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

p.src: 6  Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

en: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
u.src: 6  Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

p.src: 7  All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

en: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
u.src: 7  All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

p.src: 8  I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

en: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
u.src: 8  I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

p.src: 9  together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

en: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
u.src: 9  together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

p.src: 10  Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

en: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
u.src: 10  Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

p.src: 11  and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

en: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
u.src: 11  and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

p.src: 12  Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

en: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
u.src: 12  Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

p.src: 13  For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

en: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
u.src: 13  For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

p.src: 14  Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

en: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
u.src: 14  Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

p.src: 15  Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

en: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.
u.src: 15  Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

p.src: 16  When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

en: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
u.src: 16  When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

p.src: 17  Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

en: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
u.src: 17  Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

p.src: 18  I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.

en: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
u.src: 18  I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
